SG Outdoor Solutions

THE SHORT VERSION

We looked at how SG Outdoor Solutions shows up online — Google, the company website, Facebook, Instagram, and reviews. Three things stood out as costing customers right now:

1

Only 2 Google reviews — invisible where it matters most

What we found: The Google Business Profile is claimed and active (1930 Snook Dr, Deltona, FL; hours Mon–Sat 7 AM–7 PM; checked October 2026), but it carries just 2 reviews. Both are 5-star, including one detailed review from August 2026 praising a multi-tree removal job. Two reviews is the entire public track record.

Why it costs you: When a homeowner searches "tree service Deltona" or "tree removal near me," Google's map pack shows the three most trusted local options — and trust is measured in review count. Competitors in Volusia County carry dozens to hundreds of reviews. With 2, SG Outdoor Solutions doesn't make the cut, which means the phone never rings from the single highest-intent traffic source in the business.

What fixing it looks like: A systematic review engine — every completed job triggers a simple text with a one-tap Google review link. At even 3–4 reviews per week, the profile hits 50+ reviews in three months and starts winning the map pack.

Priority Findings
2

No Facebook presence at all

What we found: No Facebook business page for SG Outdoor Solutions could be found (searched October 2026), and the company website contains no Facebook link. For a local home-services company, this is a blank space.

Why it costs you: In Central Florida neighborhoods, Facebook is where "who do you recommend for tree work?" gets asked and answered — in community groups, on neighborhood pages, in comments. With no page, the company can't be tagged, can't be recommended, and can't show up in those conversations. Every referral that happens on Facebook happens without them.

What fixing it looks like: A claimed, completed Facebook business page with services, hours, photos of real jobs, and weekly posts (before/after job photos, storm-season reminders, crew spotlights). The page becomes the referral net.

3

No Instagram — the portfolio is missing

What we found: No Instagram account for SG Outdoor Solutions could be found (searched October 2026). The website has project photos, but they live only on the website.

Why it costs you: Tree work, screen enclosures, land clearing — this is visual work, and Instagram is where visual work sells itself. A crane lifting a tree off a roof, a new pool enclosure gleaming at sunset: that's the content that stops a homeowner mid-scroll and makes them save the number. Right now that content reaches nobody beyond website visitors.

What fixing it looks like: An Instagram business profile posting 2–3 times per week — job photos and short clips the crew is already capturing on their phones. Bio links straight to the free-estimate page.
